lines.ruling: Ruling: scope; i8949 p. 9 to 10, codes E, L, N, O and D: the project does not figure those adjustments; a filer choosing 'other' is refused at the sale by sales.bad_code on sales.one (coverage row sales.nominee_sale, refused: sales[a].bad_code), and the refusal reaches every Schedule D total and Form 1040 line 7a, so no return is completed with $0 where such an adjustment belongs. The code B part (boxes A, D, G and J) and code W part match, as the reviewer says. Rerun because the form's sales.special is now derived from sd.special_any (BUG-1127).
